scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mowen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @mowen/web build && pnpm --filter @mowen/server build
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm --filter @mowen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @mowen/server build && pnpm --filter @mowen/desktop build && pnpm --parallel --filter @mowen/web --filter @mowen/desktop dev
scripts.desktop:pack: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && tsx scripts/bundle-pi-tools.ts && pnpm --filter @mowen/desktop pack
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && tsx scripts/bundle-pi-tools.ts && pnpm --filter @mowen/desktop pack:mac
scripts.desktop:pack:win: pnpm build && tsx scripts/bundle-pi.ts && tsx scripts/bundle-pi-tools.ts && pnpm --filter @mowen/desktop pack:win
